I've replied in a thread on your #central-team message, Pree: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from your own post in #central-team on June 9. You wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver had arrived at 7:10, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

That's the only place I found it. There are no Marrow Agrisupply files in the account folder, so I can't give you a site code or address, just the store name.
